model_solution: 1. المقياس: \( r = \sqrt{1^2+1^2} = \sqrt{2} \) والسعة \( \theta = \frac{\pi}{4} \) (الربع الأول). 2. ديموافر للأس \( -5 \): \( (1+i)^{-5} = (\sqrt{2})^{-5}\left(\cos\left(-\frac{5\pi}{4}\right) + i\sin\left(-\frac{5\pi}{4}\right)\right) \). 3. \( (\sqrt{2})^{-5} = \frac{1}{4\sqrt{2}} \). 4. تبسيط الزاوية: \( -\frac{5\pi}{4} + 2\pi = \frac{3\pi}{4} \). 5. \( \cos\frac{3\pi}{4} = -\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} \) و \( \sin\frac{3\pi}{4} = \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} \). 6. الناتج: \( \frac{1}{4\sqrt{2}}\left(-\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} + i\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\right) = -\frac{1}{8} + \frac{1}{8}i \).

model_solution: 1. المقياس: \( r = \sqrt{(-1)^2+(-1)^2} = \sqrt{2} \). 2. السعة (الربع الثالث): \( \theta = \pi + \frac{\pi}{4} = \frac{5\pi}{4} \). 3. ديموافر للأس \( -3 \): \( (-1-i)^{-3} = (\sqrt{2})^{-3}\left(\cos\left(-\frac{15\pi}{4}\right) + i\sin\left(-\frac{15\pi}{4}\right)\right) \). 4. \( (\sqrt{2})^{-3} = \frac{1}{2\sqrt{2}} \). 5. تبسيط الزاوية: \( -\frac{15\pi}{4} + 4\pi = \frac{\pi}{4} \). 6. \( \cos\frac{\pi}{4} = \sin\frac{\pi}{4} = \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} \). 7. الناتج: \( \frac{1}{2\sqrt{2}}\left(\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} + i\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\right) = \frac{1}{4} + \frac{1}{4}i \).
